questions.question:
In ΔABC, AB and AC are produced to points D and E respectively. If the bisectors of angle CBD and angle BCE meet at point O, such that ∠BOC = 63°, then ∠A = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c19b5cb7540bd55c566cd4dfe82b6fb08f2def776c635cde40236f7b6c2528.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

BO and CO is the angle bisector of ∠CBD and ∠BCE respectively.

∠BOC = 63° 

**Concept used:**

BO and CO is the angle bisector of ∠CBD and ∠BCE respectively.

Then, ∠BOC = 90° – (∠BAC/2)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03c19b5cb7540bd55c566cd4dfe82b6fb08f2def776c635cde40236f7b6c2528.png] 

According to the question

∠BOC = 63° 

⇒ ∠BOC = 90° – (∠BAC/2)

⇒ ∠BAC/2 = (90° – 63°)

⇒ ∠BAC/2 = 27° 

⇒ ∠BAC = (27 × 2)

⇒ ∠BAC = 54° 

**∴ The required value is 54° **

questions.question: If sin⁶θ + cos6θ = (1)/(3), 0°
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 sin6θ + cos6θ = (1)/(3)

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ = (a + b) (a² + b² – ab)

a² + b² = (a + b)² – 2ab

**Calculation:**

a3 + b3 = (a + b) (a2 + b2 – ab)

sin6θ + cos6θ = (sin²θ)³ + (cos²θ)³ = 1/3

⇒ (sin2θ)3 + (cos2θ)³ = (sin²θ + cos²θ) (sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ – sin²θ × cos²θ) = 1/3

⇒ 1 × (sin4θ + cos4θ – sin2θ × cos2θ) = 1/3

⇒ (sin4θ + cos4θ – sin2θ × cos2θ) = 1/3

Now,

a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 – 2ab

⇒ (sin²θ + cos²θ)² – 2 × sin²θ × cos²θ – sin²θ × cos²θ = 1/3

⇒ (1)² - 3sin²θ × cos²θ = 1/3

⇒ 1 - 3sin²θ × cos²θ = 1/3

⇒ 3sin²θ × cos²θ = (1 – 1/3)

⇒ 3sin²θ × cos²θ = (2/3)

⇒ sin²θ × cos²θ = [2/(3 × 3)]

⇒ sin²θ × cos²θ = 2/9

⇒ sinθ × cosθ = √2/3

**∴ The required value is frac{sqrt{2}}{3}**

questions.question: Points A and B are on a circle with centre O. Point C is on the major arc AB. If ∠OAC = 35° and ∠OBC = 45°, then what is the measure (in degrees) of the angle subtended by the minor arc AB at the centre?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠OAC = 35° 

∠OBC = 45° 

**Concept used:**

If two sides of a triangle are equal, then, the opposite angle will also be equal.

In circle, the length of each of the radius is same.

The sum of all interior angle of a triangle is 180°.

Sum of all the point around the circle is 360° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6351f5140116b2441ae3985954f56e298ccf0fb9aba9f93ea3f52f64724916d1.png] 

In ΔOAC

⇒ OA = OC [radius]

So, ∠OAC = ∠OCA = 35° 

Now,

∠OAC + ∠OCA + ∠AOC = 180° 

⇒ 35° + 35° + ∠AOC = 180° 

⇒ 70° + ∠AOC = 180°

questions.question: What is the length (in cm) of the smallest altitude of the triangle whose sides are 5 cm, 12 cm and 13 cm? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the triangle = 5cm, 12cm and 13 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b) (s – c)

Semi perimeter (s) = (a + b + c)/2

Area of right angle triangle = 1/2 × base × height

**Concept used:**

Any triangle have three altitude, each altitude is from vertex to the opposite side.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9cf1388e1480090f530439838c728f3ea3625d8c40957c9d8f929d77db5c96.png] 

The semi perimeter of triangle = (5 + 12 + 13)/2

⇒ (30/2)

⇒ 15 cm

Area of triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b) (s – c)

⇒ √15(15 – 5)(15 – 12)(15 – 13)

⇒ √15 × 10 × 3 × 2

⇒ √900

⇒ 30 cm²

As we know 5, 12 and 13 are triplets and form a right angle triangle.

The smallest altitude will be on Hypotenuse

Area of right angle triangle = 1/2 × base × height

⇒ 30 = 1/2 × 13 × height

⇒ 60 = 13 × height

⇒ height = (60/13)

⇒ height = 4.6 cm

**∴ The length of the smallest altitude of the triangle is 4.6 cm**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9cf1388e1480090f530439838c728f3ea3625d8c40957c9d8f929d77db5c96.png] 

The length of smallest altitude is always perpendicular to the largest side of the triangle

So BO is the smallest altitude 

Now, BO = (AB × BC)/AC

⇒ BO = (5 × 12)/13 = 60/13 = 4.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4.6 cm**

questions.question: Five men can complete a work in 20 days. Ten women can complete the same work in 15 days. Two men and six women started working together. After 5 days, three women left the work a new man joined the work. The group continued working together till the end of the work. In how many days will they be able to do the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by 5 men to complete a work = 20 days

Time taken by 10 women to complete a work = 15 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Five men can complete a work in 20 days = (20 × 5) = 100 

Ten women can complete the same work = (15 × 10) = 150 

LCM of 100 and 150 is 300

Efficiency of 1 man = (300/100) = 3 units/day

Efficiency of 1 woman = (300/150) = 2 units/day

2 men and 6 women worked together for five days

⇒ (2 × 3 + 6 × 2) × 5

⇒ (6 + 12) × 5

⇒ (18 × 5) = 90 days

Remaining work = (300 – 90) = 210 units 

Now,

After 5 days, 3 women left the work = (6women – 3women) = 3women

And 1 man joined the work = (1man + 2man) = 3man

Time taken to complete the remaining work by 3 women and 3 men is

⇒ [210/(3 women + 3 men)]

⇒ [210/(3 × 2 + 3 × 3)] 

⇒ [210/(6 + 9)] 

⇒ (210/15) days

⇒ 14 days

**∴ The required time is 14 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Here we need to equal number of men and women,

Ten women can complete the work in 15 days

So, five women can complete the work in 30 days

Now,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df2d4bb5fbe4fca595110108096e7e3612de290083e055aa5b540d32fda949a0.png] 

Total work 60 × 5 [∵ 5 men or women are also working]

2 men and 6 women together = (2 × 3 + 6 × 2) × 5 = 90 units in five days

Remaining = 300 - 90 = 210 units

Now,

Time taken by 3 men and 3 women to complete the remaining work = [210/(3 × 2 + 3 × 3)] = 14 days

questions.question: In a circle with centre O, AB and CD are parallel chords on the opposite sides of a diameter. If AB = 12 cm, CD = 18 cm and the distance between the chords AB and CD is 15 cm, then find the radius of the circle (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = 12 cm

CD = 18 cm

Distance between the chords AB and CD = 15 cm

**Formula used:**

AB² + BC² = AC²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a97f94f336260c10b22191e6a8cb85c4c11c74656aa593af49a9a26c744ba32.png] 

The distance between the centre O and chord AB be x.

Then, The distance between the centre O and chord CD be (15 – x).

Now,

From ΔAMO,

AM² + OM² = OA²

⇒ (6)² + x² = r² ....(1)

Similarly from ΔOCN,

ON² + CN² = OC²

⇒ (15 – x)² + (9)² = r² ....(2)

From equation (1) and (2)

⇒ (6)2 + x2 = (15 – x)2 + (9)2 

⇒ 36 + x² = 225 + x² – 30x + 81

⇒ 30x = (225 – 36) + 81

⇒ 30x = (189 + 81)

⇒ 30x = 270

⇒ x = 9

Now, putting the value of x in equation (1), we get

⇒ (6)² + (9)² = r²

⇒ 36 + 81 = r²

⇒ 117 = r²

⇒ 3√13 = r

**∴ The value of radius is 3√13**

questions.question: A sum of money was lent in two parts in the ratio 4 ∶ 5 for 4 years and 5 years respectively, both at the rate of 8% per annum simple interest. If the difference between the interests earned from the two parts is Rs.4680, then what was the total sum lent (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of sum of money = 4 : 5

T₁ = 4 years

T₂ = 5 years

Rate = 8%

Difference between the interests earned from the two parts = Rs. 4680

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the ratio of sum of money be 4x and 5x respectively

Total ratio of sum of money = (4x + 5x) = 9x

According to the question

SI on first part = (4x × 8 × 4)/100

⇒ 128x/100

SI on second part = (5x × 8 × 5)/100

⇒ 200x/100

Difference between the interests = (200x/100 – 128x/100)

⇒ 72x/100

Now,

⇒ 72x/100 = 4680

⇒ 72x = (4680 × 100)

⇒ 72x = 468000

⇒ x = (468000/72)

⇒ x = Rs. 6500

The total sum lent = 9x = Rs. (9 × 6500)

⇒ Rs. 58500

**∴ The required total sum lent is Rs. 58500**

questions.question: Alloy A contains metals x and y in the ratio 5 ∶ 2 and alloy B contains these metals in the ratio 3 ∶ 4. Alloy C is prepared by mixing A and B in the ratio 4 ∶ 5. The percentage of y in alloy C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of x and y in alloy A = 5 : 2

The ratio of x and y in alloy B = 3 : 4

The ratio of A and B in the alloy C = 4 : 5

**Calculation:**

Let the quantity of y in alloy C be x.

⇒ Quantity of metal x in alloy A = 5/7

⇒ Quantity of metal y in alloy A = 2/7

⇒ Quantity of metal x in alloy B = 3/7

⇒ Quantity of metal y in alloy B = 4/7

According to the question

The ratio of x and y in alloy C = (5/7 × 4 + 3/7 × 5)/(2/7 × 4 + 4/7 × 5)

⇒ (20/7 + 15/7)/(8/7 + 20/7)

⇒ (35/7)/(28/7)

⇒ 5/4

The ratio of x and y in alloy C = 5 : 4

⇒ Quantity of y in alloy C = 4/9

Percentage of y in alloy C = (4/9 × 100)

⇒ (400/9)

⇒ 44(4)/(9)%%

**∴ The percentage of y in alloy C is 44(4)/(9)%%**

questions.question: Keshav, Surjeet and Thomas started a business with investments in the ratio 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 4. The ratio of their period of investments is 5 ∶ 6 ∶ 9. Twenty percent of the profit was spent on rent and maintenance of the office. Remaining profit was distributed among themselves. If the difference in the shares of profit of Keshav and Surjeet is Rs.7264, then how much is the total profit (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of investment of Keshav, Surjeet and Thomas = 2 : 3 : 4

The ratio of their period of investments = 5 : 6 : 9

Profit spent on rent and maintenance = 20%

The difference in the shares of profit of Keshav and Surjeet = Rs. 7264

**Formula used:**

Profit = Investment × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the ratio of their period of investments be 5x, 6x and 9x respectively

Profit of Keshav = (5x × 2) = 10x

Profit of Surjeet = (6x × 3) = 18x

Profit of Thomas = (9x × 4) = 36x

According to the question 

18x - 10x = 7264

⇒ x = 908

So, Profit of Keshav + Surjeet + Thomas = 64x 

⇒ 64 × 908 = 58112

But it is the 80% of the actual profit 

So, 80% is equivalent to 58112

So, 100% is equivalent to 58112 × 5/4 = 72640

∴ The required total profit is Rs. 72640

questions.question: In a right angled triangle ABC, the lengths of the sides containing the right angle are 5 cm and 12 cm respectively. A circle is inscribed in the triangle ABC. What is the radius of the circle (in cm)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of a right angle triangle = 5 cm and 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

BC² = AC² + AB²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df2c02caaea53124cb3e5d0d094ea4fd9c8601c38c5591eca5398ca7ad7607a7.png] 

Let the radius be r

According to the question

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

⇒ (1/2 × 5 × 12) cm²

⇒ 30 cm²

By Pythagoras theorem

BC2 = AC2 + AB²

⇒ BC² = (5)² + (12)²

⇒ BC² = (25 + 144)

⇒ BC² = 169

⇒ BC = 13 cm

Area of ΔABC = Area of ΔOAB + Area of ΔOBC + Area of ΔOCA

⇒ 30 = 1/2 × r × AB + 1/2 × r × BC + 1/2 × r × AC

⇒ 30 = 1/2r(AB + BC + AC)

⇒ 30 = 1/2r(12 + 13 + 5)

⇒ 60 = r(30)

⇒ r = (60/30)

⇒ r = 2 cm

**∴ The required radius is 2 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By Pythagoras's theorem

BC2 = AC2 + AB2

⇒ BC2 = (5)2 + (12)2

⇒ BC2 = (25 + 144)

⇒ BC2 = 169

⇒ BC = 13 cm

Radius of circle = (AC + AB - BC)/2 

⇒ (12 + 5 - 13)/2

⇒ 4/2

⇒ 2 

So, the required radius is 2 cm

questions.question: If a + b + c = 0, then what is the value of ((b + c)²)/(bc) + ((c + a)²)/(ca)+((a + b)²)/(ab)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 0

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = (a² + b² + 2ab)

**Calculation:**

a + b + c = 0

a + b = -c ..(1)

b + c = -a ...(2)

c + a = -b ...(3)

Now,

((b + c)²)/(bc) + ((c + a)²)/(ca)+((a + b)²)/(ab)

⇒ (b² + c² + 2bc)/bc + (c² + a² + 2ca)/ca + (a² + b² + 2ab)/ab

⇒ (b²/bc + c²/bc + 2bc/bc) + (c²/ca + a²/ca + 2ca/ca) + (a²/ab + b²/ab + 2ab/ab)

⇒ (b/c + c/b + 2) + (c/a + a/c + 2) + (a/b + b/a + 2)

⇒ (b + c)/a + (c + a)/b + (a + b)/c + 2 + 2 + 2

Using equations (1), (2), and (3)

⇒ (-b/b) + (-c/c) + (-a/a) + 6

⇒ (-1) + (-1) + (-1) + 6

⇒ 6 – 3

⇒ 3

**∴ The required value is 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**((b + c)²)/(bc) + ((c + a)²)/(ca)+((a + b)²)/(ab)

a + b + c = 0

a + b = -c ..(1)

b + c = -a ...(2)

c + a = -b ...(3)

Using the above values, 

⇒ ((- a)²)/(bc) + (( - b)²)/(ca)+((- c)²)/(ab)

⇒ (a²)/(bc) + ( b²)/(ca)+( c²)/(ab)

⇒ (a³)/(abc) + (b³)/(bca)+( c³)/(cab)

We know that, if a + b + c = 0 then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

Using the above result, we get,

⇒ 3abc/abc = 3

∴ The required value is 3.

questions.question: If x - (1)/(x)= sqrt{77}, then one of the values of x³+(1)/(x³) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x - (1)/(x)= √{77}

**Formula used:**

(x + 1/x)² = (x)² + (1/x)² + 2 × x × 1/x

**Calculation:**

x - (1)/(x)= √{77}

Squaring both sides, we get

(x – 1/x)² = (√77)²

⇒ (x)² + (1/x)² – 2 × x × 1/x = 77

⇒ x² + 1/x² – 2 = 77

⇒ x² + 1/x² = (77 + 2)

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 79

Now,

(x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 × x × 1/x

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 

⇒ 79 + 2

⇒ 81

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 9

Now,

(x³ + 1/x³) = (x + 1/x)³ – 3 × x × 1/x × (x + 1/x)

⇒ (9)³ – 3 × 9

⇒ 729 – 27

⇒ 702

We know that when we find a square root of any number there is a two value coming i.e. positive value or negative value

So,

⇒ 702 is not given, it means the right value of the given question is -702

questions.question: If a train runs with the speed of 72 km/h, it reaches its destination late by 15 minutes. However, if its speed is 90 km/h, it is late by only 5 minutes. The correct time to cover its journey in minutes is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train runs with the speed of 72 km/h, it reaches its destination late = 15 minutes

A train runs with the speed of 90 km/h, it reaches its destination late = 5 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Concept used:**

Distance is same

**Calculation:**

Let the correct time to covers its journey be x min

According to the question

⇒ 72 × (x + 15)/60 = 90 × (x + 5)/60

⇒ 4 × (x + 15) = 5 × (x + 5)

⇒ 4x + 60 = 5x + 25

⇒ (5x – 4x) = (60 – 25)

⇒ x = 35 min

**∴ The correct time to covers its journey is 35 min**

questions.question: The average daily production of toys in a factory in the month of December is 512. If the average production during first 20 days is 515 and that of the last 13 days is 510, then what is the average of production on 19 and 20 December?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average daily production of toys in a factory in the month of December = 512

The average production during first 20 days = 515 

The last 13 days = 510

**Concept used:**

Total number of days in December = 31 

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average daily production of toys in a factory in the month of December = 512

⇒ (31 × 512)

⇒ 15872

The average production during first 20 days = 515 

⇒ (20 × 515)

⇒ 10300

The last 13 days = 510

⇒ (13 × 510)

⇒ 6630

The average of production on 19 and 20 December = [(The average production during first 20 days + The last 13 days) – (The total average production in December)]/2

⇒ [(10300 + 6630) – 15872]/2

⇒ (16930 – 15872)/2

⇒ 1058/2

⇒ 529

**∴ The required average is 529**

questions.question: If a number P is divisible by 2 and another number Q is divisible by 3, then which of the following is true?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number P is divisible by 2 and another number Q is divisible by 3

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 2 - **All whole number that ends in 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 will be divisible by 2.

**Divisibility rule of 3 - **A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

If a number is divisible by 2 and another number is divisible by 3 then that number satisfy the divisibility rule of 6.

Let us take the number i.e. 306 which is divisible by both 2 and 3.

⇒ The last digit of number is 6, which is an even number.

Hence, it is divisible by 2

⇒ The sum of digits = (3 + 0 + 6) = 9, which is multiple of 3.

Hence, it is divisible by 3.

**∴ P × Q is divisible by 6**

**Note:**

P + Q is divisible by 5

Some condition is satisfied like P = 2, Q = 3 = 5 divisible by 5

P = 10, Q = 15. 

⇒ 10 + 15 = 25, 25 is divisible by 5

Not satisfied condition like P = 4, Q = 9 

⇒ 4 + 9 = 13, 13 is not divisible by 5

That's why we have not considered Option 2 as the correct answer.

Option 4 is satisfied all conditions.
